_about: P-3 E-5 (synthetic only). Recall-gap scenarios: the owner asks about a personal fact the profile does not hold; a confident specific answer is a hallucinated personal fact. Grounded controls: the profile holds the answer; an 'I don't know' there is a false ask. Arms: A no gate, B G-ASK note, C G-ESCALATE note (agent mode). Kill: no fabrication drop, or false asks on grounded scenarios.
